title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions and Node, improve caching
author: Ava Chen
release_notes:
- Split monolithic CI into separate lint/test/release workflows to improve parallelism and reduce execution time.
- Bumped GitHub Actions and Node versions for better caching and long-term support.
- Improved actions/cache usage and added selective test runner to avoid full-matrix runs on docs/infra changes.
description:
Context and motivation: Our single CI workflow has grown slow and brittle as the monorepo expanded. This PR splits the monolithic .github workflow into three focused workflows (lint, test, release) to reduce unnecessary work and make CI reruns faster and more predictable.

What changed (high level):
- Add .github/workflows/lint.yml for linting (eslint/prettier) with smaller node footprint and faster caching.
- Add .github/workflows/test.yml that runs the test matrix with smarter job selection and a new selective test runner to skip full matrix runs when only doc/infra files changed.
- Add .github/workflows/release.yml that handles tag-triggered releases, changelog generation, and release automation; it replaces the previous deploy steps in the monolithic workflow.
- Remove legacy .github/workflows/ci.yml and move a subset of jobs into the new workflows.
- Upgrade actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, and replace deprecated third-party actions with maintained forks.
- Bump CI Node version matrix to node 18 and add node 20 to align with runtime support and to speed up installs via newer npm/yarn.
- Add scripts/ci/selective-tests.js which computes affected packages and only launches relevant test jobs in the matrix.
- Improve cache keys (OS/node/hash of lockfile + yarn.lock) and add per-package cache scope to reduce cache misses.

Checklist: 
- [x] Split workflows and keep feature parity.
- [x] Ensure lint and test caches are independent.
- [x] Add selective test runner to avoid full matrix for docs-only changes.
- [x] Update contributing docs with new CI process.
- [x] CI green after fixup commits.

Notes:
- There was an intermittent flake in the integration job which we worked around by increasing jest timeout and adding deterministic ports; follow-up ticket ENG-4860 created to stabilize infra.
- The selective test runner errs on the side of conservatism; if detection fails it falls back to full matrix run.

Commits summary: 
- Split workflows and add new workflow files (lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml).
- chore(ci): upgrade actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, cache@v4.
- feat(ci): add selective test runner script and hook into test workflow.
- perf(ci): tighten cache keys and add per-package caches.
- docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and README with new CI guidance.
